scope: Read-only code and artifact audit. Model compilation and bank loading were inspected without mj_step, optimization or training. New release inspector is separate from this assessment.

latest_user_direction.interpretation: A clean physical loss on a difficult combo can be a valid training outcome. It is not a reason to demand universal defence before a bounded release. This does not authorize stale models, unconnected graphs, hidden resets, fabricated successful defence, or ignored numerical/evidence failures.

bottom_line: The repository contains a real bounded PPO training driver, but it is wired to the old five-action, single-Guard A1 family, not the current pose_set_v1 multi-node catalog.
The a1_selfplay CLI performs ZERO optimizer updates. The actual bounded optimizer loop is sim.a1_train.
The documented old v5 bank currently fails its model-hash loader check; the documented outputs/a1_prepared/library is absent in this workspace.
The new catalog cannot be supplied to the old --bank argument. A graph loader/inspector is useful packaging, but does not itself migrate the environment, policy, rollout or PPO.

old_documented_bank.load_a1_library_result: ValueError: A1 bank model hashes changed

new_catalog_as_legacy_bank.load_a1_library_result: NotADirectoryError: loader appends /bank.json to a file path

old_environment_scene_builder.old_target: one sphere per robot, local center [0.32,0,1.05], radius 0.06 m
old_environment_scene_builder.new_material_target: three disjoint left/right/upper regions, radius 0.10 m, defined by the packaged scoring snapshot

findings.finding: A1DuelEnv loads A1Library and uses build_duel_scene without confirmed joint ranges; both physical slots get legacy A1Controller. The RK4/1ms profile does not replace the old joint-coordinate limits.
findings.minimum_change: A separate versioned graph environment should use the same build_limited_duel, confirmed constraints, geometry and position_control as current qualified material trials. Do not clip or wrap new q into the old scene.

findings.finding: Legacy bank format is a directory with bank.json and exactly guard/stab/slash_left/parry_left/parry_right NPZ curves. Every path must begin and end at one exact common Guard. New catalog edges have different start/end nodes and distinct unloaded contexts.
findings.minimum_change: Load an immutable package with explicit ordered edge IDs and exact nodes/curves. Use SkillGraphExecutor per slot; only outgoing edges of the current actual stable node are available. No automatic bridge, forced return to hub, interpolation refit or context-node merge.

findings.finding: Policy/encoder are hardcoded to 5 logits and 30 features. Own action IDs are restricted to 0..4 and include a five-way one-hot. They have no explicit current graph-node/context identity.
findings.minimum_change: Create a new feature/action version from the frozen release manifest: wait=0, explicit ordered edges thereafter; encode own current node and own active action/progress without exposing opponent labels, phase or future. Reinitialize incompatible actor/encoder weights; do not relabel a five-logit checkpoint.

findings.finding: Rollout/PPO independently enforce five-action masks and 30-dimensional features; collector action counts also have length five. Updating only the actor head is insufficient. PPO currently requires the first learner decision at time zero, while SkillGraphExecutor starts unavailable until a real 100 ms stability gate.
findings.minimum_change: Version mask dimensions, feature dimensions and replay identities consistently across encoder, buffer, PPO, snapshots and export. Explicitly define shared initial warmup/decision-time origin or represent the forced initial interval; do not waive the stability gate or fabricate a time-zero decision.

findings.finding: Training env settles one old target sphere with FirstTouchScorer. Current material qualification uses separate all-three-region audits; those offline reports do not activate a three-region online reward function.
findings.minimum_change: Use one shared online three-region event definition for both slots, aggregate all events from the same 1 ms physics tick, and preserve existing foul-before-hit settlement. Keep valid physical loss distinct from invalid numeric/contact-evidence transitions.

findings.finding: Useful plumbing already exists: simultaneous current-state observations, no opponent script metadata in actor features, busy no-op exclusion, first terminal physical settlement, independent frozen opponents, complete-episode transactional buffers and no hidden retries.
findings.minimum_change: Preserve these contracts while replacing the graph/model/feature interfaces; do not rewrite the full learner solely to add the new bank.

findings.finding: Snapshots bind actual model arrays, scene config, bank data, runtime and encoder; a1_train really performs PPO updates and maintains a four-snapshot frozen opponent pool. a1_selfplay's public CLI remains a zero-update collector.
findings.minimum_change: Bind the new package hash, exact graph ordering, scorer, current constraints and new encoder/action versions. Old snapshots should fail compatibility checks.

findings.finding: Existing training is bounded A1-family versus frozen A1-family, with physical-slot alternation: 1..8 updates, 2/4/6/8 episodes per update, at most 32 episodes, 80 s per episode. It is not the planned continuous-action A2 training implementation.
findings.minimum_change: A first A1-only training release can be labelled as such. Do not claim A1-versus-continuous-A2 fairness or final cross-play; those require the later shared adapter and independent A2 actor.

findings.finding: The old learnable initialization has 0.25/s departure hazard, about 4 s expected wait when all four nonwait actions are available. Naively spreading its mass over 34 graph edges then masking the 10 initial outgoing edges gives about 13.586 s expected wait, not the original hazard.
findings.minimum_change: Define an explicit availability-aware exploration initialization for the new version and report actual wait/busy/choice statistics. This is not permission for forced attack/defence alternation or a fixed tactic.

findings.finding: Legacy environment exports decision-step traces; new validation has used full 1 ms state traces and actual 100 ms gates. The graph executor remains uninterruptible during each active edge, so observed threats can arrive while the mask is closed.
findings.minimum_change: For release regression evidence, retain full-rate diagnostics and record busy intervals and first available responses. Do not automatically unmask mid-curve; a known clean difficult-combo miss may remain a labelled limitation.

minimum_release_migration.contract: Package all exact nodes/edges, file hashes, constraints, scoring and known evidence limits. An inspect/new_executor API is a loader, not a training environment or automatic admission.

Use confirmed limited model and identical low-level controller, no new leash default. Per-slot actual graph state, 1 ms stability feedback, 10 ms targets, simultaneous 20 ms policy decisions; only explicit outgoing edges and wait/continue. Preserve context-specific unloaded nodes.

minimum_release_migration.deliverable: Common online scorer and physical outcome contract
minimum_release_migration.contract: Both slots use exactly the packaged three-region geometry and common existing legal-contact/foul settlement. Physical target losses remain valid data, including known hard-combo misses. Numerical failure or missing reliable contact provenance stays invalid and stops the staged batch. First-touch training termination and full-window diagnostic validation remain distinct.

minimum_release_migration.deliverable: New encoder, mask, buffer, PPO and snapshot versions
minimum_release_migration.contract: Eliminate five/30 hardcoding throughout. Preserve physical-time returns, complete transactions and frozen opponent identities. Resolve initial 100 ms readiness versus time-zero PPO assumption explicitly. No old-policy weight reuse by action-name substitution.

minimum_release_migration.deliverable: Bounded training and held-out attack/defence evaluation
minimum_release_migration.contract: Run a small explicit training budget only after the native adapter passes its finite regression set. Label it A1-versus-A1 if no A2 adapter exists. Do not demand universal defence or a fully trained policy to publish the usable technical entry.

finite_validation_before_new_training_en: No-integration tests: every packaged edge keeps exact knots/coefficients and named endpoints; masks reject wrong-node, 99 ms ready and busy requests; aliases cannot merge different execution contexts; altered package/score/model/action-order hashes fail closed.

Native adapter equivalence on one already-qualified attack and one observed staged defence: compare all issued references to the archived recipe; verify the online all-three-region scorer and real entry/exit gates. Reuse old material certificates as inputs, not as proof of the new environment adapter.

One known difficult continuous combo as a negative control: if physically clean but hit, preserve loss/reward and the busy-response record. Never convert it into successful defence or an invalid batch merely to improve reported success.

One complete two-episode/two-slot collection and one optimizer update: replay old probabilities under recorded masks, verify model/package identity, independent frozen opponent, unchanged opponent weights, valid sample commit and safe checkpoint reload. No long self-play campaign is required to demonstrate this technical entry.

Held-out physical attack and defence opportunities with wait/attack baselines, not only action counts: confirm that always-wait can lose, a valid attack can score, and a known defence can prevent a specific threat. Report both capacities and known misses separately.

learning_both_attack_and_defence_without.already_present_reward: Only physical terminal hit/foul rewards, timeout zero; no action-name reward in the inspected env or PPO.
not_approved_here: reward for selecting parry/attack by name
learning_both_attack_and_defence_without.minimum_training_design: Use an explicitly documented opponent/state curriculum that presents real attack opportunities and real threats, then mixed/free decisions. Any task mode or active-region choice must be public and part of snapshot identity. This changes exposure, not the physical score or the actor's selected move.
learning_both_attack_and_defence_without.evaluation: Measure physical scoring, being hit, response opportunities, actual loaded interception and known counterattack outcomes on held-out episodes; choosing both names does not prove either ability. A short technical PPO run cannot promise learned balanced fencing.
learning_both_attack_and_defence_without.future_A2_boundary: Keep shared model, physical observation availability, scoring and time budgets compatible with later A2. A1-only release does not demonstrate the continuous A2 adapter or final frozen-policy cross-play.
